systems.owner: Statistics South Africa (national statistical system); consultancy run by SADC Secretariat under World Bank-funded Regional Statistics Project P175731

note: SADC call for expressions of interest (issued 2026-09-09, closing 2026-09-23) to recruit a consultant to draft a South African NSDS within 180 days; the strategy is only planned and the drafting not begun, so no fact.

facts.fact: Stats SA told Parliament's Appropriations Committee on 28 April 2026 that it has put in place, as a risk mitigation, the development of the National Strategy for Developmental Statistics to determine data gaps; the document gives no adoption date.
